objective: Make a game in progress survive a server restart (NFR-14), per the 'Game survival (#47)' block now in api.ts (base 696f3ad). Produce: (1) store schema v2 in apps/server/src/store.ts by migration from PRAGMA user_version 1 (existing v1 rows keep working): games in status 'playing' are saved too, and enough per-game state to rebuild a Game exactly: player colour, the move list (UCI + by), status/result/endReason, timestamps, whether the bot is due to move, and the tutor state (open question INCLUDING the server-held reveal text/move, whether the reveal was already shown, the pending tutor request kind/fen if tutor.thinking). Your choice of shape (extra columns, a moves table, a JSON column for tutor state) — keep the PGN column filled so FR-5 PGN export is unchanged. (2) games.ts writes to the store before every HTTP reply or SSE event that announces a change: player move, bot move, takeback, bot-retry, resign, game end, new game (and the old game's abandonment), tutor_thinking start, tutor_reply, reveal, attempt. (3) Startup: createGameManager (or a new load step called from main.ts/app.ts) loads every 'playing' game from the store into memory; if it's the bot's turn it asks the bot again; if the tutor was thinking it re-runs that ask (same kind, same fen) with the usual SSE. Shutdown (preClose / abandonAll) no longer abandons games; it only ends open streams. Starting a new game still abandons any other game still 'playing' (unchanged contract). (4) GET /api/games/:id serves a saved game from the store when it is not in memory (finished or abandoned games after a restart); 404 only for an id never created. (5) GameView.tutor.reveal is set once a reveal has been shown for the open question (POST reveal or wrong try) and cleared when the question closes; null otherwise. Tests: a restart mid-game (game manager A on a file-backed SQLite in a temp dir, play moves incl. a takeback and a tutor question, close A without abandoning; new manager B on the same DB file; GET shows the same moves/fen/question; the next player move is accepted and the bot replies); bot-due-on-restart re-asks the bot; tutor-thinking-on-restart re-asks the tutor (fake tutor); a finished game is still GET-able after restart; schema v1 DB migrates.
contract: Cause (issue #47): games in progress live only in memory (Map at apps/server/src/games.ts:237); store.ts saves only finished/abandoned games (store.ts:7, schema v1 = one games row with whole PGN, PRAGMA user_version=1); shutdown abandons live games (app.ts:171 preClose -> games.abandonAll(); games.ts:790). Render restarts the service on every deploy (disk-backed, no zero-downtime), so games must come back from SQLite. The contract (api.ts, inlined below) is the source of truth for observable behaviour; the new parts are the 'Game survival (#47)' block and optional TutorStatus.reveal. Reveal text must still never reach the browser before a reveal (architecture 3.5): storing it in SQLite is fine, sending it in GameView before it's shown is not. 'Before acknowledging' means synchronous node:sqlite write before reply.send / subscriber emit; node:sqlite DatabaseSync is synchronous, so no awaiting needed. Keep one DB connection per process. Premises checked at 696f3ad: pnpm test 46 files / 973 passed; pnpm typecheck clean. Existing tests that assert shutdown abandons games (apps/server/test/shutdown.test.ts, outcome-pgn-store.test.ts, games-api.test.ts) must be updated to the new contract, not deleted. Parallel work: web-agent (brief 062) is doing the browser side (routing /games/<id>, rebuild from GET, Reconnecting with backoff) in apps/web only; it relies on GET /api/games/:id + SSE first 'state' + tutor.reveal as in api.ts.
